Power 
 Station | Technical 
 Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, to be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Technical Specifications:
Load 800 kg, Delta / Y, 220 / 380V, 17/4.2 kW, 1435 / 330 rpm, 60/135A, 34 
/20A
The 
first draft initiated & tested by eng. Ashraf Loka Fikry, 
accepted by eng. Soliman Abdel-Fatah: general manager, approved by eng. 
Abdel-Karem AbuZaid: High Dam head sector, and certified by eng. Kamel 
Ragheb Hakem: HPGC quality control general director & MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Wear 
 the
 appropriate
 safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glasses ... etc
Stop the elevator and Switch off the AC, DC for the elevator
Suitable warning boards.
Tools and Equipment
Safety and healthy equipment
Set of common screw drivers, wrenches
Cleaning material, grease for lubricating.
Avometer and clamp
Work to be Carried Out
Dismantle the motor cable terminal and sign 
 it
Dismantle the coupling and motor
Dismantle fly wheel and dismantle motor back 
 cover
Dismantle the motor forward cover and 
 carryout the rotor
Cleaning the stator from dust and increasing 
 winding insulation
Check motor bearing and change one if it is 
 needed
Mantle the motor after insulation drying
Cleaning motor main contacts for magnetic 
 resistance
Cheek electric brake coil
Collection the motor with gears and electric 
 cables
Check elevator and make it on
